correctness.rationale: Common strictly increasing cumulative hazard maps to independent exponentials and preserves Kendall tau. Exponential-race first spacing L is Exp(1), independent of residual mixture R; the Laplace difference kernel gives tau=E exp(-|R-Rprime|) and the exact double sum over q_i=1-p_i. Sorting p=(a,a+b,a+b+c)/(3a+2b+c), independent exact SymPy rational reconstruction verified the positive-denominator numerator is homogeneous degree 8 with all 40 nonzero coefficients positive, minimum 16, maximum 183048 and sum 1743120; it vanishes precisely b=c=0. At p=(0,1/2,1/2), tau=1/3,V=1/6 giving sharp ratio 2/5. The boundary is a limit not interior equality.
